body.name: Observed-data Rao--Blackwell seed estimator
body.construction: On the branch \(M_n<n\), first set \(\pi_i(G)=q_i(G)^{k_n}>0\). For every assignment \(z\) of positive seed-design probability, compute \(w_i(z;G)=\mathbb E[k_n^{-1}\sum_{\ell=1}^{k_n}\mathbf 1\{J_\ell=i\}\mid Z^{\mathrm{seed}}=z,G]\), and set \(\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{seed}}=\sum_{i\in V_n}w_i(Z^{\mathrm{seed}};G)y_i(Z^{\mathrm{seed}})-n^{-1}\sum_{i\in C_G(Z^{\mathrm{seed}})}y_i(Z^{\mathrm{seed}})/\pi_i(G)\). No object in this definition is formed on the branch \(M_n\ge n\).
